description_en: Add DDL statements to a virtual data source instance in your current workspace. Alibaba Cloud GBI parses these DDL statements to extract and maintain table schema information
description_zh: 向您当前指定的业务空间下指定的虚拟数据源实例中添加ddl语句，析言GBI云服务会将您的ddl语句解析成相关的表结构信息并进行维护
kebab_example: aliyun dataanalysisgbi save-virtual-datasource-ddl --workspace-id llm-2v3934xtp49esw64 --vdb-id vdb-E0F693C8-9F72-5830-B81A-696C9D8EBBD1 --ddl 'CREATE_TABLE_user_id_int_NOT_NULL_AUTO_INCREMENT_comment_ID_,name_varchar_10_NOT_NULL_comment_姓名_,_dept_id_int_NOT_NULL_comment_部门ID_,_salary_bigint_NULL_DEFAULT_0_comment_薪水_,_PRIMARY_KEY_id_,_KEY_idx_name_name_,_KEY_d_id_dept_id_,_CONSTRAINT_d_id_FOREIGN_KEY_dept_id_REFERENCES_department_id_COMMENT=_This_is_my_table_ENGINE=InnoDB_AUTO_INCREMENT=20094_DEFAULT_CHARSET=utf8' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SaveVirtualDatasourceDdl

parameters.help_en: ID of the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace used for this request
parameters.help_zh: 当前请求所使用的阿里云百炼业务空间id
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: ID of the virtual data source instance
parameters.name: vdb_id

parameters.example: CREATE TABLE user (id int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT comment 'ID',name varchar(10) NOT NULL comment '姓名', dept_id int NOT NULL comment '部门ID', salary bigint NULL DEFAULT 0 comment '薪水',  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),   KEY `idx_name` (`name`),   KEY `d_id` (`dept_id`),    CONSTRAINT `d_id` FOREIGN KEY (`dept_id`) REFERENCES `department` (`id`)) COMMENT='This is my table' ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=20094 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 ;
parameters.help_en:
A CREATE DDL statement for a database. You can pass multiple statements. Separate them with line feeds (
)
parameters.help_zh: create类型数据库ddl语句，支持传入多条，多条之间请用换行符分割（“\n”）
parameters.name: ddl
